objective: USINE run 'b1x-init-test' translated from a transport block (adapters/cr-propagation/assets/usine_translate.py)

extension.input_manifest_note: sha256 is of each file as run, with the absolute paths of the run directory and of USINE's inputs folder written into usine.init.par; committed_form_sha256 is of the same file written with the placeholders <TOOL_HOME>/inputs and <RUN_DIR> (the form committed under tests/adapters/fixtures/cr_propagation/usine/inputs/), equal to sha256 for the files that hold no path; entries with read_in_place are USINE's own files (GPL-2.0), hashed where they lie and never copied

tools.name: USINE
tools.version: V3.5 (git tag V3.5, commit fb53006db41d1a640bf1b5af1a4b0f899ca59673; built with Apple clang 21.0.0 against ROOT 6.38.04)

seeds.note: USINE's local-flux calculation is deterministic: no random numbers are drawn

tolerances.note: USINE EPS_ITERCONV 1e-6, EPS_INTEGR 1e-4, EPS_NORMDATA 1e-10 (written into the initialisation file); outputs printed with 6 significant digits

extension.exit_status_note: exit_status is the run's outcome as judged by usine_translate.py (0: every expected output written, no USINE error or crash in the log); USINE V3.5 itself returns 1 on every path (usine_exit_status)
notes: 10Be half-life: USINE chart 1.387 Myr, NUBASE2020 1.387 My (core.constants.physical)
14C half-life: USINE chart 5.73 kyr, NUBASE2020 5.7 ky (core.constants.physical); differs by +0.53%, USINE's chart value is used
local bubble of radius 0.203802 kpc (USINE rhole): USINE damps BETA-unstable fluxes in the disc only (valid at z = 0)
diffusion.form 'beta^eta (R/R0)^delta with smooth breaks': not parsed; K = beta^eta K0 (Rig/R0)^delta times the break factors is fixed by the canonical fields
high break form (1 + (Rig/R_break)^((delta - delta_above)/s))^(-s): USINE V3.5's shipped K formula (inputs/init.TEST.par line 133) with Deltabreak = delta - delta_above

electron-capture decay on at the laboratory half-life of USINE's chart, rate ln 2 / (gamma t_1/2) (USINE V3.5 src/TUAxesCrE.cc GammaRadEC_perMyr); electron attachment and stripping are not modelled (r3 P6)

cross_sections.ghost_threshold 'USINE chart crcharts_Zmax30_ghost97 (ghosts folded into cumulative cross sections)': not parsed; ghost nuclei are not loaded (IsLoadGhosts false; the cumulative cross sections of USINE's chart crcharts_Zmax30_ghost97.dat) and tertiary chains are off
sources.injection species_group ['all primaries']: one slope for every primary of the network
sources.spatial 'thin disc (1D model)': not parsed; the 1D model's sources fill the thin disc

gas 'uniform in the thin disc, n_HI = 0.867 cm^-3, n_HII = 0.033 cm^-3, n_H2 = 0 cm^-3': HI = 0.867, HII = 0.033, H2 = 0 cm^-3, He = He_to_H_number x (HI + HII + 2 H2) = 0.1 cm^-3 in the thin disc; targets H, He
cross sections: USINE's own files XS_NUCLEI/sigProdGALPROP17_OPT12.dat (production) and XS_NUCLEI/sigInelTripathi99+Coste12.dat (inelastic), read in place from HEP_USINE_DATA (GPL-2.0, never copied)
Kpp with USINE's shipped km/s -> kpc/Myr factor 1.022712e-3 (inputs/init.TEST.par line 134), 1.6e-07 below the IAU parsec and Julian year value 1.022712165e-03 used with the ILLUSTRATIVE sets
source spectrum dQ/dE_k/n = q Rig^-2.26892 (USINE POWERLAW, eta_s = -1)

source abundances: solar-system isotopic fractions and abundances with the FIP bias (USINE kSSISOTFRAC, kSSISOTABUND, kFIPBIAS, solarsystem_abundances2003.dat), then each element normalised to data of USINE's crdata_crdb20170523.dat: H,He to PAMELA at 20 GeV/n; C,N,O,F,Ne,Na,Mg,Al,Si to HEAO at 10.6 GeV/n; pure secondaries Li,Be,B
network: every nucleus of USINE's chart crcharts_Zmax30_ghost97.dat from 1H to 30Si; no antinuclei; tertiary chains, ghost nuclei and exotic primaries off
family "BIG (USINE's shipped example, a high break only)": a label of the model family, not read by the translator
free []: one run fixes every parameter; a fit varies the free ones
energy grid given explicitly: 33 E_k/n nodes from 0.05 to 5000 GeV/n
